dedupe_keys.name: historical crop yield simulations for ghana kenya and zimbabwe from lpjml forced with era5 land

description: The resource contains historical crop-yield simulations produced with LPJmL5 and ERA5-Land reanalysis forcing. The provider states a 1980 to 2024 period and 0.1-degree grids for Ghana, Kenya and Zimbabwe. NetCDF files cover the main crops grown in each country. These reference simulations support the Foodshed Information Service forecasting work. Coverage: 1980-2024 Geographic extent follows the named site or scope; unstated extents and sampling intervals remain unknown. Access: public 4TU.ResearchData metadata links describe the release. Formats: NetCDF, JSON and plain text. Licence: CC-BY-SA-4.0. Cost and present file access are unverified. Caveats: Simulated yields are not observed harvests; the exact crop list and output completeness were not independently checked. Simulation uses follow the source-defined purpose above. Related resources are retained in the same native collection with their distinct identities.
